python3 << 'EOF'
# Department of Defense military outlays (millions of dollars) from FY 2011-2020
data = [678077, 650869, 607801, 578013, 562506, 565365, 568905, 600705, 653979, 690420]

# Sort the data in ascending order
sorted_data = sorted(data)
print("Sorted data:")
for i, v in enumerate(sorted_data, 1):
    print(f"Position {i}: {v}")

# Calculate Hazen Plotting Position for the 85th percentile
# Formula: P = (i - 0.5) / n
# For 85th percentile: 0.85 = (i - 0.5) / 10
# Solving: i = 0.85 * 10 + 0.5 = 9

n = len(sorted_data)
p = 0.85
i = p * n + 0.5
print(f"\nFor 85th percentile: i = {i}")

# Interpolate between position 9 and 10
pos = int(i)
fraction = i - pos

print(f"Position: {pos}, Fraction: {fraction}")

# Get values at position 9 and 10
value_at_pos_9 = sorted_data[pos - 1]
value_at_pos_10 = sorted_data[pos]

print(f"Value at position {pos}: {value_at_pos_9}")
print(f"Value at position {pos + 1}: {value_at_pos_10}")

# Linear interpolation
result = value_at_pos_9 + fraction * (value_at_pos_10 - value_at_pos_9)
print(f"\n85th Hazen Percentile (interpolated): {result}")

# Round to nearest hundredths
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredths: {round(result, 2)}")
EOF
